base_member_text: [L110-L134,L180-L231,L278-L323,L380-L463,L525-L606,L659-L725,L769-L837,L900-L1019,L1092-L1223,L1303-L1417,L1455-L1570,L1730-L1753] (LOW/unchecked MPI status) MPI return codes are stored throughout the module but never tested, so communication failures are not distinguished from valid results.
audit_member_text: [L110-L134,L180-L231,L278-L323,L380-L463,L525-L606,L659-L725,L769-L837,L900-L1019,L1092-L1223,L1303-L1417,L1455-L1570,L1729-L1753] (MED/mpi/error-handling) MPI status codes are consistently captured but not checked, so communication failures can leave partially populated arrays or enter later waits with invalid requests.

adversarial.rationale: This alternate module is excluded from the checked-in library builds: Makefile.am selects general_mpi.F90, and both Intel library projects select the same active file. The captured-but-unchecked statuses in general_mpi_new.F90 cannot cause the claimed runtime failure in those builds.

base_member_text: [L716-L725,L828-L837,L1403-L1417,L1556-L1570] (MED/MPI error scope) Local size-consistency failures abort MPI_COMM_WORLD rather than the communicator supplied to the routine, potentially terminating unrelated communicator participants.
audit_member_text: [L716-L722,L828-L834,L1403-L1414,L1556-L1567] (MED/communicator-scope) Shape mismatches abort MPI_COMM_WORLD rather than the communicator passed to the routine, unexpectedly terminating unrelated ranks in an embedded or split-communicator use.

base_member_text: [L421-L454,L563-L596] (MED/nontermination edge case) If sum(ln(1:procs)) is zero on the root, the unconditional loop has no send event that can reach its exit test and runs forever; no positive-dimension precondition is enforced.
audit_member_text: [L389-L454,L534-L596] (HIGH/mpi/liveness) Both column-send root loops terminate only after incrementing sends, so a valid zero-total workload makes the unbounded loop advance j forever.

adversarial.rationale: The zero-column loops are present, but general_mpi_new.F90 is not compiled by the supplied Autotools or Intel projects; general_mpi.F90 supplies the module instead. In addition, the alternate file's matrix_distr interface selects sendmat routines rather than these column-send routines (general_mpi_new.F90:59-66).

base_member_text: [L445-L455,L463;L587-L606] (HIGH/nonblocking buffer lifetime) Both column-wise send routines deallocate the contiguous send buffer aa before all outstanding MPI_Isend requests are completed, violating MPI buffer-lifetime requirements and risking corrupted transfers.

audit_member_text: [L80-L137] (MED/bounds-contract) Vector distribution indexes is/lm by communicator size and copies lm elements into b without validating metadata extents, source ranges, or destination capacity.
[L142-L326] (MED/scatter-metadata) Scatter variants trust is/lm/js/ln and local matrix shapes completely, allowing invalid displacements, counts, or b columns to be passed to MPI.
[L408-L470,L553-L615] (LOW/resource-use) The send variants allocate a full bb copy on the root even though bb is only read on non-root processes.
[L619-L841] (MED/bounds-contract) Whole-matrix distribution computes array sections from unchecked metadata and root rank before validating that source and destination shapes match.

[L928-L1024,L1102-L1225] (MED/collection-metadata) Column collection derives counts, receive totals, and array sections from unchecked overlap flags and metadata, so inconsistent flags can produce negative counts, missing receives, or out-of-bounds sections.

[L1296-L1417,L1449-L1570] (MED/minimum-extent) Whole-submatrix collectors subtract a fixed four-cell overlap without enforcing local dimensions of at least four, allowing negative extents and MPI counts.
[L1575-L1618] (HIGH/arithmetic-input-contract) decomp divides and takes modulo by numprocs without rejecting zero, and does not validate myid against the process range.
[L1668-L1710] (MED/output-bounds) det_submatrices assumes all eight output arrays contain at least mp*np elements and that ma/na exceed the fixed overlap, but validates neither condition.
[L1714-L1753] (MED/minimum-extent) Border shifting forms rows/columns 2 and ma-1/na-1 and uses count ma-2 without checking that the matrix has sufficient dimensions.
